pages.title: Electromagnetic Rail Cannon
pages.text: A kinetic weapon that uses an electromagnetic rail to accelerate massive armor-piercing shells. It can fire effectively only when mounted on the rail face of a valid Electromagnetic Rail Core; see $(l:vsie:peripheral/electro_magnet_rail)Electromagnetic Rail/$.$(br2)Its shells depend on the rail for acceleration, so their penetration increases with the rail's effective length.$(br2)The weapons division is developing another directed-energy weapon based on the same rail system.
